about: Merge admission policy (development/contracts/execution-admission/MergeAdmission.v0.1.md, Owner Decision d130195e). Read by scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs from the default branch only. The recommended table (§5.2, §5.3), from step 2 (Owner Decision 73050422): in normal every layer needs a claim and the merge slot, code may re-run all jobs once per head and docs twice; efficiency only advises the claim and the merge slot for code and docs. The protected layer's rules are the code constant PROTECTED_BASELINE, never this file; the state is the Owner's repository variable CLUED_MERGE_ADMISSION_STATE (unset: normal). A malformed file judges every pull request as frozen.
